purpose: Independent TimesFM3-inspired model: industrial forecasting usefulness; demand/PSI remains a separate main track

source.timestamp_timezone: source-naive interpreted as UTC for this study; not verified equipment timezone

calendar.selection: first 13 timestamp-complete days excluding 2020-02-21; no quantity-based replacements

conversion.availability: all selected readings available at bin end; actual delivery latency not validated
conversion.aggregate: math.fsum of all selected raw readings / count, float64 then float32
conversion.timestamp_complete: 1440 occupied bins and max within-day consecutive raw gap <=60s; not quantity/normal-operation completeness
conversion.selected_raw_missing_nonfinite: fail entire conversion; do not omit bad readings
conversion.quality_window_guard: reject full common candidate on invalid context or target in any of 3 targets; apply fixed daily 90 percent floor
conversion.note: quality guard cannot rescue a converter failure

scale.population: each stored float32 training bin once, all 7 days, chronological order
scale.arithmetic: cast to float64; math.fsum / N mean; math.fsum squared deviations / N variance; sqrt
scale.tensor_dtype: float32; exact rounded values pinned and promoted to float64 for metric arithmetic
scale.finite_positive_checks: mean/variance/sigma finite, T/floor finite and positive before and after float32 rounding
scale.context_normalization: existing forward CPU float32 mean/std(correction=0), using only 128 context bins

training.loss: existing training_loss: context-normalized mean quantile pinball, float32
training.sampler: local random.Random(seed): randrange(7) day, then randrange(len(common ordered day origins)), with replacement for each of 32768 samples
training.paired: one initial state and complete sampling schedule per seed shared between variants; separate fresh optimizer state

selection.ties: earlier step, exact numeric equality, no epsilon
selection.baseline_selector: per target validation day-equal MAE; exact tie last-value
selection.test_score_gate: all 3 seed pairs selected and every test prediction plus baseline predictions pinned before any test scoring
selection.moving_average_15_arithmetic: math.fsum last 15 stored float32 values cast to float64 / 15; round forecast once to float32

metrics.aggregation_order: float64 math.fsum: q, lead, origin within day, target, day; seeds equally after per-seed scores
metrics.wis: 2 * mean pinball across three quantiles (same day/target weights)
metrics.point_score: p50 MAE per target in original units; do not average native units
metrics.mechanism_rule: mean-seed full pinball < self-only and at least 2/3 paired seeds improve; exploratory only
metrics.point_rule: per-target mean-seed full MAE < validation-fixed baseline and at least 2/3 seeds improve; report all targets
metrics.ratio_zero_denominator: null plus absolute difference; never silently substitute epsilon
metrics.coverage_and_miss: coverage includes both endpoints; lower/upper miss use strict inequalities

failure: close incomplete with all prefix/source/stdio/exit/state retained; stop remaining units, no reseed/replacement/extension
